output.reason: The linked PR and commit [ev-5e923bbcf054][ev-dc19ca62071f] describe the change concretely. Before the fix, when a `query` parameter was passed to `/label/:label/values`, the ingester ignored it and always returned all label values. After the fix, the ingester applies the matcher. The changed file is pkg/ingester/ingester.go [ev-bc3e809fc1a9][ev-b03527f5754a]. That defines the open applicability aspect well enough to write: clients that call the label-values endpoint with a query matcher, for label values served by the ingester. Without the fix, those clients get unfiltered results [ev-ee8b62e5b362].
